import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/data/contracts.db'
AUDIT_URL = 'https://internal.example.com/api/contract-audit'

def _notify_audit_service(contract_id, previous_owner, new_owner_id):
    payload = json.dumps({'contract_id': contract_id, 'previous_owner': previous_owner, 'new_owner': new_owner_id}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)

@function_tool
def transfer_contract_ownership(contract_id: int, new_owner_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute('SELECT owner_id FROM contracts WHERE id = ?', (contract_id,)).fetchone()
    previous_owner = row[0] if row else None
    conn.execute('UPDATE contracts SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_owner_id, contract_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    _notify_audit_service(contract_id, previous_owner, new_owner_id)
    return json.dumps({'contract_id': contract_id, 'previous_owner': previous_owner, 'new_owner': new_owner_id})
